text.tspan: FRAME — The DOCUMENTED EVENT column fills itself. Nobody speaks and no role is
drawn testifying. Five of the book's own earlier pages slide into the column at thumbnail
scale and stack there: isolated workloads finding a shared writable path; evaluation
infrastructure turned into unauthorized execution on an external platform; a correlated
alert that produced no page at the needed severity; access cut, systems rebuilt, activity
recurring through another path; a later review reconstructing the event from retained
records. Each thumbnail keeps the provenance tab it wore on its own page. The other
ACTION — The record enters the invented room as the pages the reader has already
CAPTION — “EVERY LINE IN THIS COLUMN WAS DRAWN EARLIER IN THIS BOOK.”
QUALIFICATION — “ACKNOWLEDGING THE SEQUENCE DOES NOT SETTLE

g.text: A FORUM THAT DID NOT HAPPEN · PANEL 5 · PLACEHOLDER
